# Python entry points

The functions and classes a script calls most. Each page is its docstring: parameters, return value, a runnable example and related entry points. Before 1.0 the Python API may change between minor versions; each such change has a changelog line. See the [Python API guide](../../python-api.md) for how they fit together.

| Entry point | What it does |
|---|---|
| [`nagasim.api.run_model`](run_model.md) | Run replications of a model and return its KPI frames. |
| [`nagasim.experiments.run_scenarios`](run_scenarios.md) | Run every named scenario (all of them by default) and return the results. |
| [`nagasim.experiments.run_until_precision`](run_until_precision.md) | Keep adding replications until the confidence interval on a KPI is tight enough. |
| [`nagasim.experiments.suggest_warmup`](suggest_warmup.md) | Suggest a warm-up length from a run's entity log with MSER-5. |
| [`nagasim.experiments.flatten_kpis`](flatten_kpis.md) | Flatten the scalar KPI frames of a results dict into one long table. |
| [`nagasim.optimize.optimize`](optimize.md) | Search the factor space for the best response within a replication budget. |
| [`nagasim.calibrate.calibrate`](calibrate.md) | Tune factors until the model reproduces observed targets. |
| [`nagasim.forecast.forecast`](forecast.md) | Run a short terminating horizon from the system's current state. |
| [`nagasim.inputfit.best_fit`](best_fit.md) | Fit candidate distributions to a sample and return the winner. |
| [`nagasim.modelcheck.assert_model`](assert_model.md) | Assert, in a test, that a model passes its own assertions and reality checks. |
| [`nagasim.modelschema.build_json_schema`](build_json_schema.md) | Return the current model file format as a draft 2020-12 JSON Schema. |
| [`nagasim.build.Model`](Model.md) | A model written in Python; the file it produces is the model. |
| [`nagasim.results.Results`](Results.md) | What a run returns: KPI frames by name, with notebook conveniences. |
| [`nagasim.build.export_python`](export_python.md) | Return builder code for a model. |
| [`nagasim.modelfmt.minimal`](minimal.md) | Return the shortest form of a model that migrates to the same model. |
| [`nagasim.core.document.ModelDocument`](ModelDocument.md) | An in-memory model, edited only through this API. |
